<!--
Before filing: ROADMAP.md lists what is planned and what was deliberately
declined, and FEATURE-IDEAS.md collects ideas that aren't scheduled. Yours may
already be there — a comment on an existing item is more useful than a new
issue.
-->

## What's the problem?

What are you trying to do that Schl8 makes hard or impossible? Describe the
situation rather than the solution — it often has more than one.

## What would you like it to do?

Your proposed behaviour, concretely. Where would it live: a menu item, a
shortcut, a config key, a CLI subcommand?

## How do you work around it today?

If you do.

## Does it affect the security model?

Be honest here, and don't worry if you're unsure — it just helps triage.
Anything that would move decrypted text somewhere new (a file, the clipboard,
another process, the network) is a much bigger ask than it looks, and some of
it is ruled out by design. The invariants are listed in
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Anything else

Screenshots, links to how another tool does it, prior art.
